system.description:
15th Level Clan Feature

You are one with the wood. You are the commander of the green. All things in nature are part of your domain. Hostile creatures of your choice that are Grappled or Restrained as a result of a Senju Hijutsu or are standing in an area under the effects of the New Growth special terrain has their chakra network impeded. When a hostile creature with an impeded chakra network casts a Jutsu that requires chakra molding (CM) of a rank higher than the listed rank based on their classification, they gain ranks of Drained for every rank above the listed rank that they cast the triggering jutsu at.

Standard: D-Rank

Elite: C-Rank

Solo: B-Rank
